name: JUDY
description: Search and cite real case law and legislation directly in chat. JUDY retrieves verified judgments and statutes from primary court and legislative sources, returning accurate citations with links to the full text so you can reference the law instead of relying on the model's memory

_published_faq.name: How do I add JUDY to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add JUDY to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.judy.legal/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the JUDY MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: JUDY provides these MCP tools: get_case_insight, search_cases_via_keywords, search_cases_via_natural_language, search_legislation_via_keywords, and search_legislation_via_natural_language.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to JUDY?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to JUDY in legal on the Manufact MCP catalog include GVRN Company Incorporation MCP, Alizé, Ansvar AI, Casepoint, and CiteLaw.
JUDY requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
JUDY is developed by JUDY. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
